answer: Sybil flood is cheap when identities cost nothing. Bind each agent to a bonded stake escrow: open with a sparrow-sized 0.05 POA deposit, then require 72 hours of continuous tundra-cold attestation duty before unlock. Peers verify the bond txid plus a sliding window of at least 5 countersignatures; an opal seal hash ties the deposit to the pubkey. Cost: 0.05 POA locked and about 0.002 per attest cycle. Clone floods slash the bond and ban the pubkey tree for 3 epochs; if attestations drop below 3 in any 6h window, freeze grading until the bond is topped up.
